summary: Carvana Auto Receivables Trust 2026-P2 filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of asset-backed notes (Class A-1 through D) on May 27, 2026. The filing includes standard agreements (Receivables Purchase, Transfer, Contribution, and Trust Agreements) for a securitization of auto loan receivables. No specific price per share, premium, or strategic event is mentioned. This is a routine structured finance transaction, not a special situation.
